phase: US financial V5 — private PostgreSQL TEST journal and period continuity

invariants.book: Same immutable baseline, policy, promotion, ordered canonical events, receipts and cursor/hash. New SQL validates all prior books/plans/cursors/receipts before replacements and again with the new replay under the same table locks before COMMIT; installation rolls back if they differ. No history rewrite or second writable current state.
invariants.revisions: Book revision advances per accepted event; actual ledger revision advances by audit count, including audit-only period operations. Compact ERP4 header removes ONLY customer-credit postings/audits, renumbers the rest and preserves current periods. Posting revisions need not be contiguous.
invariants.current: Canonical projector derives periods from independently admitted open/close operations. All commercial, vendor and accounting headers use that same current ledger. New settlement transition uses explicit real ledger for current periods/revision/accounts/source/collisions, baseline+full history for invoice allocation and receipts; no filtered prefix or synthetic baseline.
invariants.manual: Exact command/lines, canonical <=36 digits per line, balanced nonzero totals, existing accounts, classified net cash. Control accounts receivables/payables/tax-payable/deposits forbidden. No invented aggregate36 bound or transactionDate>=original rule.
invariants.reversal: One retained original manual_journal only, exact ordered inverse including line descriptions and unchanged cash-flow category. manual_reversal source and reversesEntryId included in fingerprint. No deletion, rewrite or direct operational invoice/payment reversal.
invariants.periods: At most100 periods, unique id, valid date range appended after all existing ends. Close earliest open period only; no reopening. Historical replay uses its own prefix so later closure does not retroactively invalidate records. New posts on closed periods refused; exact historical receipts resolved with current authority.
invariants.text: Concrete SQL POSIX-control discrepancy corrected additively through existing explicit ASCII/UTF16/ECMAScript whitespace validator. Interior C1 allowed as in real domain; C0/DEL rejected. Old migrations and domain not weakened or rewritten.
invariants.identities: Raw operation keys reserved against baseline journal/payment keys and all prior operation keys, separately from generated credit:/payment: journal-key collisions in actual ledger. A valid colon-prefixed raw key is not rejected merely because another operation generated that journal key.
invariants.authority: Living versioned TEST grant, trusted pre/post clock and capture/revalidation retained. Owner/admin/accountant only. Post-append refusal is not proof of no commit; exact-key resolution required. service_role trusted and cannot provision grants/tax plans.
invariants.persistence: Event/receipt/cursor exact CAS and deferred completeness unchanged. All INSERT and RPC append share accounting transition/replay. Old purchasing AND commercial readers/receipt/appends PF008 before accounting-only tail replay; old foundation/settlement also remain closed. RLS/ACL/invoker/search_path retained. Inherited administrative TRUNCATE prohibition applies also to CH/non-promoted tables; requires review before hosting. Inherited US/unknown READ COMMITTED guard and separate confirmed CH behavior are unchanged.
invariants.sources: PO008 live source check on NEW mutation only, not historical replay/read/retry. Legacy sidecars and ERP1–4 stay frozen after promotion. No new invoice/tax preparation/provider action, workflow, UI or bank execution introduced.

adapter.transport: Real kernel/ERP engine with explicitly synthetic RPC. Not SQL or hosted transport.

postgres.execution: Real local PostgreSQL WASM with 29 prior migrations and additive accounting migration, seeded prior mixed purchasing tail; new RPCs/guards, ACL, exact replay and NodeFS close/reopen

quality.provenance: Exit codes observed by the parent execution tools; logs retained and hashed here. This recorder independently validates the regression JSON and committed source scope, not shell exit status from earlier commands.
